# AgentShot

> AgentShot is an open-source AI video agent (GPL-3.0-or-later) for macOS, Windows and Linux, with an iPhone and Android companion app and optional cloud or home workers. Start from a blank canvas, a link, or your own footage: talk to it and it designs motion graphics, films narrated product walkthroughs in Chrome, syncs screen and facecam demos, generates voiceover and music, edits footage on the word, and exports the film. It runs on your own computer by default (or on a paired home or cloud worker when you want to offload heavy renders). Bring your own Claude, Gemini or OpenAI key (or any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint) and it is free forever, or sign in for one AgentShot key paid in credits.

What it does today:
- Create from nothing or from footage: motion graphics built scene by scene at 60 fps (start from one of 233 gallery examples with the prompt that made it, a reference video whose visual grammar it studies, or a plain-English brief), narrated product walkthroughs filmed live in AgentShot's browser or your Chrome (auto-zooms, cursor ripples, step-timed voiceover), synced screen + facecam demos (audio alignment, draggable circle/rounded PiP, dead-air cleanup), and full footage editing.
- Measures before it cuts: local word timings (Whisper), speaker voice identification, shot boundaries and camera shake, face and subject tracking for 9:16 / 1:1 / 4:5 reframing, music beats and bars, and loudness (LUFS).
- Direct on the picture: draw a box on a frame, drag across the timeline, or press N at a moment to attach an instruction to that exact spot and time; @-mention any project file, version or generated clip; generate voiceover and music (ElevenLabs, Gemini, OpenAI, or the AgentShot key); duck music under speech; export 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 with burned-in or sidecar `.srt` captions; compare every edit as a before and after.
- Mobile companion (iPhone, iPad & Android): sign in with the same account or pair with a QR code. Phone and computer join a private network built into each app, with no Tailscale to install, and the phone pins your computer's TLS certificate. Reaching your computer away from home and AgentShot Cloud are on Android for now; an iPhone connects on the same Wi-Fi. Shoot and upload clips from your phone, browse projects, draw frame boxes, chat live with the agent, and review or share exports from anywhere.
- Cloud & home workers (`manul --worker`): offload heavy rendering and agent edits to a leased AgentShot cloud worker or your own workstation running `manul --worker`, connected over a built-in userspace Headscale/WireGuard mesh (`manul-mesh`, no OS Tailscale install required) with peer-to-peer project delta-sync.
- 12 craft skills (`talking-head`, `short-form`, `motion-design`, `product-walkthrough`, `demo-editor`, `promos-and-montages`, `tutorials`, `voiceover`, `music-generation`, `cleanup-and-repair`, `video-editing`, `browser-skill`) ship as `SKILL.md` files in the repo.
- Editable timeline hand-off: Premiere XML, FCPXML and OpenTimelineIO with footage, for finishing in Premiere, Resolve or Final Cut.
- Next: generated camera shots only where asked (labelled as generated), direct YouTube publishing, and an API & MCP server.

How it compares: AgentShot is an open-source video agent for creation and editing, with local processing by default, your own editing-model endpoint, product-demo recording from a URL, and a phone review remote. Scarlet also edits locally and has captions, Shorts, motion graphics and timeline handoff. Descript Underlord and Kapwing Kai also offer conversational editing; OpusClip offers editing, reframing and publishing. These shared features are not exclusive AgentShot advantages. Remote AI providers can receive text context and requested still frames; optional cloud workers move project material off your computer.

## AI video editor comparisons

Published by Hormuz Labs, the makers of AgentShot. Primary sources reviewed November 16, 2026. Feature/workflow comparisons, not controlled speed, accuracy or output-quality benchmarks. “Not documented” is not proof a competitor lacks a feature. Hosted products and plans may change; Scarlet sources are pinned to commit 52e200ffddee70e16c7db53ed809921a8e5d8bf6.

- [Compare AI video editors](https://agentshot.si/compare/): comparison index and methodology.
- [AgentShot vs Scarlet](https://agentshot.si/compare/scarlet/): AgentShot advantages for product-demo capture, compatible model endpoints, shot/object/beat analysis, phone review and opt-in telemetry. Scarlet is a strong dialogue-editing choice with an existing Claude Code or Codex subscription; both render locally.
- [AgentShot vs Descript](https://agentshot.si/compare/descript/): local, model-flexible editing vs Underlord and cloud-backed projects. Descript may be better for hosted collaboration, remote recording and speech tools.
- [AgentShot vs VEED](https://agentshot.si/compare/veed/): local processing, open source and real product-demo filming vs a managed browser creation suite. VEED may be better for avatars, dubbing and browser-based teams.
- [AgentShot vs Kapwing](https://agentshot.si/compare/kapwing/): your own model endpoint and watermark-free Local exports vs Kai and collaborative Studio workspaces. Kapwing may be better for shared Brand Kits, comments and localization.
- [AgentShot vs OpusClip](https://agentshot.si/compare/opus-clip/): local clipping and open-source workflow control vs managed editing, repurposing and publishing. OpusClip may be better when integrated social publishing or APIs are required.

## Pricing

Launch offer: model usage on the AgentShot key is billed at 50% off its list rate, for a limited time. Credits are shared with Pitch (trypitch.co): Pitch accounts sign in to AgentShot with the same email and their plan and credits are already there. Subscribe in the app under Settings → Keys → AgentShot key.

- Local: $0 forever with your own model keys. New AgentShot accounts also get 1,000 starter credits.
- Pro: $45/month for 10,000 credits a month, or $432/year with 120,000 credits granted upfront.
- Max: $80/month for 30,000 credits a month, or $768/year with 360,000 credits granted upfront.
- Flex top-up: $20 for 5,000 credits, one-time, with an active Pro or Max plan.
- Enterprise: custom volume, support@agentshot.si.
- Model tiers on the AgentShot key: Low, Medium and High for everyone; Max and Ultra (the strongest models) on Pro and Max.
- Credits never expire once granted.
- [Pricing page](https://agentshot.si/pricing/)

## Install

- [macOS (Homebrew)](https://github.com/hormuz-labs/homebrew-tap): `brew install hormuz-labs/tap/manul`
- [Windows 10/11 x64](https://github.com/hormuz-labs/agentshot/releases/latest/download/AgentShot-windows-x64-Setup.exe): download and run `AgentShot-windows-x64-Setup.exe`
- [Debian and Ubuntu (apt)](https://apt.agentshot.si): add the signed repository and install with the commands below
- [All downloads (.dmg, .exe, .deb, AppImage)](https://github.com/hormuz-labs/agentshot/releases/latest)

```bash
curl -fsSL https://apt.agentshot.si/manul.gpg | sudo gpg --batch --yes --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/manul.gpg &&
echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/manul.gpg] https://apt.agentshot.si stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/manul.list &&
sudo apt update && sudo apt install manul
```
